references.text: Describes the same event where Jesus sends the blind man to Siloam to wash and regain his sight.
The Pharisees ask the healed man how he received his sight, and he repeats the story about clay and Siloam.
Continued account of the healed man testifying that he went to Siloam and washed.
Neighbors ask how he received his sight, leading to his answer in verse 11 about Siloam.
